hypothesis: The upper-left corner search clips centered identities and low suit symbols on browser cards

initial_full_face_only_result.interpretation: Synthetic cards include a third decorative symbol, so a strict two-band whole-face extractor abstains

retained_experimental_path: Full-face extraction only when exactly two bands exist; otherwise use the existing corner extractor

latency_observation.scope: Single sequential evaluation passes, image IO through neural inference; not a repeated controlled latency benchmark
latency_observation.interpretation: Adaptive extraction adds work; unchanged accuracy does not imply unchanged latency

limitations: Browser examples influenced extractor design and are development data, not an independent evaluation
One capture session with correlated frames and draft DOM geometry
Browser recognition remains weak even with oracle glyph crops
False card proposals, unresolved hero/board roles and uncalibrated probabilities remain
No card identity is confirmed for coaching
next_work: Review browser glyph geometry, collect additional independent browser sessions and train a recognizer with font/suit domain variation under a declared split protocol
